# Diana Barry

## Overview

- **Age:** Thirteen years old when first introduced  <sub>[v1 c12 P21](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0021)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c12 P21](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0021), [v1 c12 P22](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0022)</sub>
- **Status:** Alive  <sub>[v4 c4 P3](../source/v04-c04.md#nw-v04-c04-p0003), [v4 c4 P9](../source/v04-c04.md#nw-v04-c04-p0009)</sub>
- **Origin:** Orchard Slope, Avonlea  <sub>[v1 c8 P37](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0037)</sub>
- **Role:** Homemaker  <sub>[v4 c4 P3](../source/v04-c04.md#nw-v04-c04-p0003), [v4 c4 P9](../source/v04-c04.md#nw-v04-c04-p0009)</sub>

## Appearance

Diana is a remarkably pretty girl with black eyes, glossy black hair, and rosy crimson cheeks. She inherits her merry expression from her father and is known for her stylish appearance and bright dresses.

_Sources: [v1 c8 P40](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0040), [v1 c12 P21](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0021)_

## Personality

Diana is a pleasant, cheerful, and good-natured girl who routinely laughs before she speaks. Though practical and prone to following social expectations, she is a deeply loyal and supportive friend. She reads voraciously and possesses a kind and sensible disposition.

_Sources: [v1 c8 P40](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0040), [v1 c12 P22](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0022), [v1 c12 P26](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0026), [v1 c19 P70](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0070)_

- Pretty and neat  <sub>[v1 c8 P40](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0040), [v1 c12 P21](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0021)</sub>
- Loyal and supportive friend  <sub>[v1 c12 P35](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0035), [v1 c19 P70](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0070)</sub>

## Abilities

- Good at geometry
- Talented singer

## Goals

- To be a devoted bosom friend to Anne Shirley  <sub>[v1 c12 P25](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0025), [v1 c12 P36](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0036)</sub>
- To take music lessons  <sub>[v1 c19 P83](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0083)</sub>

## History

Diana Barry grew up at Orchard Slope in Avonlea. As a child, she met Anne Shirley in her mother's garden and swore an oath to be her lifelong bosom friend. After an incident involving currant wine, her mother briefly forbade her from playing with Anne, but their friendship was restored after Anne helped treat her sister Minnie May's croup. Diana shared many childhood misadventures with Anne, including jumping onto a spare room bed that turned out to be occupied by her grandaunt, Miss Josephine Barry. She attended Avonlea School alongside Anne and later served as treasurer for the Avonlea Village Improvement Society. Rather than attending Queen's Academy, she remained at home. In adulthood, she married Fred Wright, becoming Diana Wright, and went on to have children, including Fred and Small Anne Cordelia. She actively helped prepare for Anne's wedding to Gilbert Blythe at Green Gables.

_Sources: [v1 c8 P37](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0037), [v1 c12 P22](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0022), [v1 c12 P25](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0025), [v1 c12 P35](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0035), [v1 c12 P36](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0036), [v1 c19 P70](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0070), [v1 c19 P81](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0081), [v1 c19 P85](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0085), [v4 c4 P3](../source/v04-c04.md#nw-v04-c04-p0003), [v4 c4 P9](../source/v04-c04.md#nw-v04-c04-p0009)_
